title: 36 Hours in Florence
abstract: Florence, Italy, still has the ability to surprise, with modern art, specialty shops and trendy bars. And with breathtaking gardens overlooking it all, not only is the city flourishing, it’s in full bloom.

title: 36 Hours in New York
abstract: With so much to see, the trick is to edit out the visual distractions — just as with any good photograph.

title: 36 Hours in Milan
abstract: Shopping, strolling and eating on a weekend tour of this Italian city.

title: 36 Hours in Milan
abstract: Step outside the central shopping district and you’ll find a growing number of stores that showcase young fashion and furniture designers. And an exploding restaurant scene.

title: 36 Hours in Paradise
abstract: A weekend in Bali, what could be the perfect tropical retreat.
glocations: Far East, South and Southeast Asia and Pacific Areas

title: 36 Hours in Bali
abstract: There are stunning sunsets, sculpted rice terraces and a temple on almost every corner. And for less-spiritual seekers, this steamy Indonesian island also has great surfing and a rollicking night life.

title: 36 Hours in Savannah
abstract: New ideas join the old in the heart of the gracious South.
